notablePrerequisites:
Vhal has at least seven toughness.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least seven {C} that cannot be used to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.
